title: Deleting the active Whisper model leaves config pointing at a missing model

evidence.quote:
service.delete_model(model_name)
    config = get_or_create_config(session)
    return WhisperModelsResponse(
        active_model=config.whisper_model or "base.en",

if not service.is_downloaded(request.model):
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
            detail="Model must be downloaded before activation",
        )
    config = get_or_create_config(session)
    config.whisper_model = request.model

reasoning: The route allows deleting any known model without checking whether it is the configured active model. Immediately after deletion it still reports the unchanged config value as active_model, so the API can return an active model that is no longer downloaded. The active-model setter already enforces that active models must be downloaded, so this route breaks the same invariant and can cause later local transcription attempts using the persisted config.whisper_model to fail until a user manually selects another downloaded model.
reproduction: Set active model to a downloaded model such as tiny.en, call DELETE /config/whisper/models/tiny.en, then call GET /config/whisper/models. The response still reports active_model as tiny.en while that model's downloaded/status fields indicate it is absent.
recommendation: Either reject deletion of the active model with 409 Conflict, or atomically switch config.whisper_model to another downloaded model and commit that change before returning the response.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No linked tests were provided, and repository search did not find backend tests covering the Whisper model management endpoints or active-model deletion behavior.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add an API test that creates a config with whisper_model set to a downloaded model, invokes DELETE /config/whisper/models/{model}, and asserts the route either returns 409 or updates active_model to a model that remains downloaded.
minimumFixScope: Update delete_whisper_model in app/api/config.py to preserve the invariant that config.whisper_model always refers to a downloaded model, and add focused endpoint coverage.
